seo.title: Al-Murshid: a calm companion for the five moments of your day
seo.description: Prayer times you can trust, the Quran as it is printed, remembrance, and Fajr Rise, the alarm that gets you up for Fajr. No ads, no trackers, in Arabic, English and French.

hero.title: A calm companion for the five moments of your day.
hero.body: Prayer times you can trust, the Quran as it is printed, remembrance, and an alarm that gets you up for Fajr. No ads, no trackers, no account needed.

day.title: The day, in five lights
day.body: Al-Murshid leads with what matters now, then gets out of the way.

fajr.title: Rise for Fajr
fajr.body: Fajr Rise follows Fajr every day and keeps ringing until you’re really up: a few sums, a walk, or a code you keep away from your bed. Hold for ten seconds to turn it off, any morning you need to.

dhuhr.title: The Quran, as it is printed
dhuhr.body: Four editions of the mushaf with their own pages and fonts, tajweed colors, word-by-word meanings, and recitations you can keep for offline.

asr.title: Remember Allah, anywhere
asr.body: The whole screen counts, with a light touch for every bead. Try it here.

maghrib.title: Your sky, not a score
maghrib.body: Each prayer you log adds a light to that day’s sky. No streaks, no red marks, nothing to lose.

isha.title: Your evenings stay yours
isha.body: A short reflection after Isha: one gratitude, one intention, a note. Sealed on your phone, behind your lock if you like.

items.device: Your prayers and notes stay on your device

everywhere.title: In your language, on your phone and the web
everywhere.body: Arabic, English and French from the first screen. Widgets on your home and lock screens. Everything works offline.

closing.title: Begin with the next prayer.
closing.stores: The Android and iPhone apps are on their way to the stores.

footer.sources: Prayer times are calculated on your device. City names: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).
